name: Kick Master
author: Addicting Games
description: Kick Master is a free mobile soccer game. You shoot, you score, GOAL! Soccer is the most exciting sport in the world and it unites everyone for a few weeks a year at the world cup. Train your fingers to go all the way with this soccer shooter game that lets you make the shots, get the goals, and take the adoration that goes along with it. In this game, you're forever in a penalty kick situation. You can warm up with a few shots against an open net to let you figure out the physics of the game but once you get going you'll be up against a world-class goalie who is just as eager to stop your shots as you are to take them. Within the goal, there are targets that you are supposed to try and hit. You can still score points for getting it in the net but you'll get more points for hitting the target. This game lets you keep playing basically as long as you are successful. As soon as you miss three times its game over. So, you're gonna have to make every shot count.
